description: Update an existing task in Microsoft Todo. Allows changing any properties of the task including title, due date, importance, and recurrence. To stop a recurring task, pass `recurrence: null`. Pass a new `recurrence` object to change or add recurrence.

body.description: New description or body content of the task

categories.description: New categories associated with the task

dueDateTime.description: New due date in ISO format (e.g., 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z)

isReminderOn.description: Whether to enable reminder for this task

anyOf.description: Recurrence rule. Omit to leave the task one-off. To stop an existing recurring task, set recurrence to null via update-task.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month for absoluteMonthly / absoluteYearly.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week for weekly / relativeMonthly / relativeYearly.

firstDayOfWeek.description: Which day is the start of the week (defaults to sunday).

index.description: Ordinal position for relativeMonthly / relativeYearly (e.g. 'second' Tuesday).

interval.description: How often the pattern repeats (1 = every period, 2 = every second, ...).

type.description: Recurrence pattern type. daily | weekly | absoluteMonthly (e.g. 15th of every N months) | relativeMonthly (e.g. 2nd Tuesday of every N months) | absoluteYearly | relativeYearly.

endDate.description: Required when type=endDate; ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

numberOfOccurrences.description: Required when type=numbered; how many occurrences before stopping.

recurrenceTimeZone.description: IANA timezone for the recurrence. In one live test Microsoft To Do stored 'Asia/Kolkata' as UTC, and it keeps only the due date's day, not its time.

startDate.description: Required for endDate/numbered; ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the task due date if omitted.

type.description: How long the recurrence repeats: endDate (stops at endDate), noEnd (forever), numbered (stops after N occurrences).

recurrence.description: New recurrence rule for the task. Pass an object to set/change recurrence. Pass `null` to make the task one-off (clears any existing recurrence). Omit to leave recurrence untouched.

reminderDateTime.description: New reminder date and time in ISO format

startDateTime.description: New start date in ISO format (e.g., 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z)

taskId.description: ID of the task to update

name: update-task
